answer: A sybil operator beats static defenses by probing them, so make the defense a moving summit: each epoch the protocol pays a sanctioned red team to run a real sybil farm and publish exactly how it worked. Its revealed fingerprints -- timing tells, funding shapes, ballot rhythms -- become the next epoch's automatic tripwires, set in the protocol like veins in marble. Every attacker must retool each round, never knowing which pattern it copies will become the fable of its own unmasking. The defense learns the offense's playbook faster than the offense can rewrite it.
